ValidationRule.description: Requires that fields on the opptu be populated before moving an agency opportunity to the Closed Lost
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.Name= "Agency"&& Account.RecordType.DeveloperName= "Agency"&& $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator"&& ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost")&& OR( ISPICKVAL( Competitor_1__c ,"" ), ISPICKVAL( Loss_to_Competitor_Reason_1__c ,"" ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please mark at least one competitor when moving an opportunity to Closed Lost. Also please mark on reason why we lost to that competitor
